titleJapanese: 東京マラソンへの挑戦
summary: Sora lines up with thousands of runners at Shinjuku, chasing his dream to cross the marathon finish line.
author: Sora
storyJapanese: 新宿の都庁前には、大勢のランナーがスタートを待っています。号砲が鳴り、一斉に走り出しました。沿道からの温かい声援がソラに勇気を与えます。三十キロを過ぎて足が重くなっても、諦めずに前へ進みます。ついに東京駅のゴールテープを切りました。
storyEnglish: In front of the Tokyo Metropolitan Government building in Shinjuku, a large crowd of runners waits for the start. The starting gun sounded, and everyone took off running all at once. Warm cheers from the roadside gave Sora courage. Even when his legs grew heavy past the thirty-kilometer mark, he advanced forward without giving up. Finally, he broke the finish line tape at Tokyo Station.
